body.label: Target
body.html: A sphere of radius 1 centered within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, willing creatures in the area gain +1 Fortitude against ranged attacks; the center space is difficult terrain for enemies.

surges.html: Extend difficult terrain to an adjacent empty space.
One willing creature in the area suppresses one ordinary Poison penalty until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Ward
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: anchor the center. Trigger: an enemy voluntarily enters the center space. Echo: push it 1 unit away after entry and make it Slowed 1 until your next turn.
